name: Smart Scrubber
description: Swaps names and identifiers for stand-ins before your text reaches claude.ai, and restores them only when you ask. Runs locally.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; style-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; frame-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
